air_override.method: Before adding any layer, replace each TMM instance _air_prop key below with the corresponding frozen problem value. rho0, c0 and z0 then read the overridden values. Pressure is used by circular pore properties. Source eq_fluid ignores rho. Source constant_z assigns the whole surface and clears the preceding membrane. Source backing=air uses z0/cos(theta)/srad, s0=1; srad is each case radiation_area_m2 in m^2 (default 1). Oblique and diffuse grids come from source metadata; radiation is the source low-ka pipe load. Paris produces absorption only; diffuse z remains the separately computed field impedance.
